operatingModel.principle: One evidence system, many discovery surfaces.
operatingModel.approvalRule: Every public change, campaign, advertisement, and generated draft requires founder approval.
operatingModel.measurementRule: Readiness scores measure ClearPath implementation quality, not search demand, ranking probability, or revenue.
operatingModel.truthRule: Only verified ClearPath product capabilities and measured first-party outcomes may be presented as facts.

families.name: Search discovery
families.description: Findability in conventional, answer, generative, local, voice, video, social, and app-search surfaces.

families.name: Knowledge and authority
families.description: Entity clarity, machine-readable relationships, citation readiness, and demonstrated trust.

families.name: Experience and conversion
families.description: Accessible journeys that connect discovery to useful content and measurable conversion.

capabilities.name: Search Engine Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Connect verified search intent to canonical, indexable ClearPath pages.

capabilities.name: Generative Engine Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Make factual ClearPath explanations easy for generative engines to retrieve and cite.

capabilities.name: Answer Engine Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Answer real market-education and product questions clearly and directly.

capabilities.name: Large Language Model Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Improve factual representation of ClearPath in language-model retrieval without manipulating models.

capabilities.name: AI Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Coordinate AI-facing discovery work across AEO, GEO, LLMO, AISO, and GSO.

capabilities.name: AI Search Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Prepare pages for AI-assisted search experiences that combine links and generated answers.

capabilities.name: Generative Search Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Coordinate page structure for generative search result experiences.

capabilities.name: Social Media Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Adapt approved ClearPath education and product demonstrations to each social network.

capabilities.name: Social Search Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Improve discovery inside social-network search while preserving platform-native language.

capabilities.name: Video Search Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Make approved educational videos understandable and discoverable before and after playback.

capabilities.name: Hashtag Search Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Use a restrained, platform-specific hashtag vocabulary as supporting metadata rather than a growth claim.

capabilities.name: App Store Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Prepare accurate store listing language and creative for released ClearPath applications.

capabilities.name: Local and Regional Search Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Match reviewed regional and translated content to appropriate geographic search contexts.

capabilities.name: Voice Search Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Structure concise, speakable answers for verified educational and product questions.

capabilities.name: Entity Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Keep ClearPath Trader, its company, founder, products, and public pages unambiguous.

capabilities.name: Knowledge Graph Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Express verified relationships among ClearPath entities, topics, products, and educational resources.

capabilities.name: Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trust
capabilities.purpose: Expose first-hand experience, accountable authorship, sources, and product truth.

capabilities.name: Conversion Rate Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Improve measured progression from qualified visit to registration, trial, and paid membership.

capabilities.name: Search Experience Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Ensure the destination satisfies the intent that produced the visit.

capabilities.name: Accessibility and Assistive Optimization
capabilities.purpose: Make discovery content and conversion paths usable across assistive technologies and different cognitive needs.
